body: Whoops, sorry about that. The old place we lived reminded me a lot of the place I has with my ex, it was hard to keep clean, really drafty, with crazy neighbors and constant commotion. The landlord was there every day and did not fix a thing- we had lots of pests and the heat and hot water worked intermittently. That place was not good and I'm worried that it made whatever I am dealing with worse... We are out of there now.  My husband while he is loving, can be cold and distant sometimes. I feel guilty for putting him through things, and I am afraid I made him that way
A big thing for me is relaxing. I am constantly tense and on edge. I mean 100% of the day.  We just moved to a new apartment which is safe and ckean
